input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

This scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 麻烦：请问，麻烦 means “trouble” or introduces a request for someone to do something; it cannot by itself introduce an information question. 请问 is the appropriate polite question opener here. [rule: word_choice]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 这就要看你想不想生病了：这就要看是哪种植物了，this pattern should give the condition that determines the answer to the earlier question. Whether someone wants to get sick does not answer which plants can be eaten; the phrase after 看 is correctly a question form in the revision. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 以后：后来，when it begins a new sentence and means “afterwards,” use 后来 rather than 以后. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：那个人，别人 distinguishes other people from a person already being discussed. Here, the listener is the same person who asked the question, so use a specific reference. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，this later narrative event is presented as completed, so the verb needs 了; speaking verbs take the zero particle only when they directly introduce quoted speech. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 麻烦不能单独用来引出这个信息问句，而请问可以。
原句虽不如改法直接，但“看你想不想生病”可以合理地说明是否该吃有毒植物。
这里叙述后续事件时应使用“后来”，不能单用“以后”。
此处是神农向一般的人们说明植物，应用“人们”而非指某一个人的“那个人”，且改后句中仍有“哪些”的问题。
教师认可此处用零标记的“告诉”，并未要求加“了”。
